title: Floor-Plan Extraction from Images

blueprintSignals.name: Wall segmentation
blueprintSignals.definition: intersection-over-union of the predicted wall mask against labelled plans
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Clutter such as furniture symbols and hatching confuses the mask, so evaluate per drawing style

blueprintSignals.name: Dimension OCR
blueprintSignals.definition: recognised numbers and units next to walls, converted to metres
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: A misread digit changes the scale by ten, so validate against the stated area

blueprintSignals.name: Room label OCR
blueprintSignals.definition: recognised room names mapped to a fixed room taxonomy
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Names are in many languages and abbreviations, so normalise by locale

blueprintSignals.name: Area consistency
blueprintSignals.definition: sum of room areas divided by the stated total area
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Stated totals include or exclude walls and balconies, so allow for the convention

engineFeatures.meaning: how strongly a region stands out from its neighbourhood
the strongest local contrast anywhere in the image
contrast divided by the image's own noise level
which scanner or camera produced the image

label: For "Floor-Plan Extraction from Images": Convert floor-plan images into structured rooms, dimensions and layouts for search, valuation and 3D tours. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Training on clean CAD exports hides failures on the hand-drawn and scanned plans that most listings contain.
